principle_violations.reason: The Order class has multiple responsibilities: managing order items and their quantities/prices while also managing the order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create separate classes for managing items and order status, thus adhering to the single responsibility principle.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor interface does not enforce that its implementations should handle various order types which can lead to issues if a different order type needs to be processed.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define a common base class or interface for Order so that all processors can rely on the same structure/order properties.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
